title: fragmosa uniflora
intro: Fragmosa uniflora, commonly known as the "fragrant plant," is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat a variety of health issues, including digestive problems and respiratory infections, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Fragmosa uniflora include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate symptoms of fever and cold, and soothe digestive issues.
